name: ignited-stab-prepare-1-paid-non-assassin-no-class-bonus
notes: Ignited Stab (GRkBQ1Uvir, FIRE ASSASSIN ATTACK, reserve 1, printed power 2): "Prepare 1. [Class Bonus] On Attack: If Ignited Stab was prepared, it gets +2 POWER." Player 2 keeps the deck's default Spirit of Fire champion (class SPIRIT, not an Assassin) with 1 preparation counter: Prepare 1 is not class-gated, so it can be paid (counter spent, card tagged PREPARED), but the +2 POWER is a [Class Bonus] and is NOT applied: 2 damage. The generated onAttack gated this with IsClassBonusActive($player) and no class list (always true for any champion); GAWrapClassBonusGate() now re-gates it on ASSASSIN.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] On Attack: If Ignited Stab was prepared, it gets +2 POWER.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Second defect behind the Ignited Stab wiring: the generated onAttackAbilities['GRkBQ1Uvir:0'] gated '[Class Bonus]' with IsClassBonusActive($player) called with NO required-classes list, which only checks 'controls any champion' (always true), so a prepared Ignited Stab played by a non-Assassin champion would still have gotten +2 POWER. Fix: GAWrapClassBonusGate($onAttackAbilities, 'GRkBQ1Uvir:0', ['ASSASSIN']) in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php (same wrapper re-gates Coup de Grace's critical 4 and Thousand Refractions' wake-up/return).
